panels.description: Composite throttle signal (0 = no throttle). Turns orange ≥10, red ≥50. Triggers GPUThermalThrottlingSustained at sustained pressure.
panels.title: Throttle Pressure Score

panels.title: Firing GPU Alerts — All (fleet-level alerts have no Hostname/UUID)
GR Engine Active & Tensor Core Active (0–1)
VRAM Utilisation
panels.description: GPU framebuffer memory in use as % of total (used ÷ (used + free) × 100). Orange ≥80%, red ≥95%. High VRAM pressure causes workload OOM kills and accelerates thermal/power degradation.

links.title: GPU memory panels — SRE Deep Dive

panels.title: DCGM Exporter Targets
panels.description: Number of nvidia-dcgm-exporter pods Prometheus is successfully scraping. Zero means no GPU hardware metrics are flowing — all DCGM panels will show No data.

panels.title: DCGM Scrape Success Rate
panels.description: Fraction of nvidia-dcgm-exporter targets Prometheus scraped successfully in the last interval. Below 90% triggers GPUDCGMScrapeDegraded (warning). Below 100% means some GPU nodes are producing no metrics.

panels.title: Firing GPU Alerts
panels.description: Count of ALERTS{platform=gpu-monitoring, alertstate=firing}. Any value above 0 means at least one GPU alert rule has triggered. Green = no active incidents.
